title: Stripe to Amazon EventBridge
description: Create an EventBridge inbound webhook for Stripe.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This stack deploys an inbound webhook that subscribes to events from Stripe and receives them on an Amazon EventBridge event bus for further processing.

EventBridge is a serverless event bus that enables you to build scalable event-driven applications by routing events between your own applications, third-party SaaS applications, and other AWS services.
This pattern deploys one Lambda function with a function URL, one Secrets Manager secret, and a CloudWatch alarm.

bullets.text: Amazon EventBridge now supports receiving events from GitHub, Stripe and Twilio using Webhooks
